newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Lend Lease rises on strong profit result.
newsitem.headline: Lend Lease rises on strong profit result.

text.p: The share price of financial services and property group Lend Lease Corp Ltd rose on Friday as brokers strengthened their assessment of the growth stock.
Shares in Lend Lease, which reported a 15 percent rise in 1996/97 (July-June) net profit on Thursday, were 42.3 cents higher at A$29.40 at 11.20 a.m. (0120 GMT).
It has reached a 1997 high of A$30.85 and a low of A$21.08, making it one of the strongest performers on the Australian Stock Exchange.
"The results yesterday were fantastic, really pointing to sustainable long term growth. I think that has just been confirmed for the market place," said James Capel broker David Irons.
Lend Lease said its rise in net profit to A$322 million was achieved by solid performances from its funds management and insurance operations, along with higher returns from its equity investments.

"Looking behind the numbers it is still a very solid result with a very visible ability to improve that over time," said Irons, who pointed to revenues now in the pipeline from large construction projects.
